Had a great experience planning my Phuket trip with Travel Dilse, coordinated by Sumeta. Everything was smooth and well managed from start to finish.

✔️ Flights and airport transfers were seamless and on time.
✔️ Hotel had a great location, was very kid-friendly, and turned out to be an excellent find. Definitely worth adding to the recommended list for future travelers.
✔️ All excursions were well organized, punctual, and enjoyable.
✔️ The itinerary matched exactly what was discussed in advance, so there were no surprises during the trip.

What stood out most was Sumeta’s approach throughout the trip planning and execution. She was proactive from start to finish, always available, responsive, and handled things with a very human touch rather than making it feel transactional. We genuinely felt well taken care of throughout the journey.

A small area for improvement: the hotel’s breakfast had limited vegetarian options, which was a bit disappointing. It would also be helpful to share a list of recommended vegetarian restaurants with ratings beforehand for travelers with dietary preferences.

Overall, a very well-planned trip and a positive experience. Thank you, Travel Dilse and Sumeta
